jo (devex): FYI support got two bugs this week where the async client throws on 502 HTML pages and the sync client returns a confusing HttpError shape. Customers complain about not being able to see the raw response.

tara (py-sdk): Ugh. Are we still calling resp.json() unguarded in our internal helper? Iirc there's a common helper used by both sync/async paths.

lee (support): Example from customer logs: 
```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8

<html>Service temporarily unavailable</html>
```
They got an exception that just said "JSON decode error" with no body or request id.

morgan (types): Parity note: the sync client uses requests.Response.text fallback in one place but the async path doesn't. We should unify. Also our HttpError type in types.pyi should expose: status_code: int, headers: Mapping[str,str], raw_text: Optional[str], json_body: Optional[Mapping[str,Any]], request_id: Optional[str]. Right now the runtime HttpError has .status and .body which confuses type checkers.

tara (py-sdk): Proposed implementation plan: 
1) Wrap json parsing like: 
```py
try:
    parsed = await resp.json()
except (ContentTypeError, JSONDecodeError) as e:
    parsed = None
    raw_text = await resp.text()
    exc_cause = e
else:
    raw_text = None
    exc_cause = None
```
2) Construct HttpError(status_code=resp.status, headers=resp.headers, raw_text=raw_text, parsed_json=parsed, __cause__=exc_cause)
3) Add aliases for backwards compat: `.status` property -> `.status_code`; `.body` -> `.raw_text`.
4) Make decode failures retryable only for 5xx by default. Configurable via RetryConfig.

jo (devex): Sounds good. Add a tiny example in the README on how to inspect the error: `except HttpError as e: print(e.raw_text or e.parsed_json)`.

morgan (types): Also add typing for `__cause__` in the stubs as Optional[BaseException] so IDEs show the underlying error class. We should run mypy on the SDK package in CI.

ops-bot: ci:py-sdk/unit-tests #1023 queued

lee (support): Tests to include from support perspective: 1) content-type text/html returns HttpError with raw_text set. 2) content-type application/json with error payload sets parsed_json and raw_text None. 3) ensure request-id header is captured when present. 4) old code paths using `.status` still work.

tara (py-sdk): I'll add unit tests and an integration test using aiohttp test server to emit different content types. Also add a small sync/async parity test to ensure fields match across both clients.

jo (devex): One more ask from customers: include a short helpful repr for HttpError like `<HttpError 502 service html... request_id=xyz>` so it's easy to see in logs. Not verbose but includes status and truncated body.

morgan (types): Agree. Keep repr stable to avoid churn. Deprecate old properties with warnings.warn(DeprecationWarning) in next major.

tara (py-sdk): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/py-sdk/pull/801 - includes exception enrichment, typing stubs, tests, and README snippet.

jo (devex): Verified PR branch with a small flask mock: raw_text present and retries retried on 502 decode. Closing this thread when PR merges.
